independent_final_review.conclusion: No unresolved blocking finding in the requested final static review. All three previously reported verification/export gaps have been corrected. Engine/converter review remains accepted after the large-dimension correction. This reviewer did not execute builds, rendering or check-existing.

checks.subject: Package parser and cleanup
checks.result: Count 1..127; IDs 1..127 unique; dimensions 1..320 by 1..200; reserved fields zero; full header/palette/entries required; exact EOF checked. Failure, reload and PAL_FreeText clear every allocated slot. At most 127*320*200 = 8128000 raster bytes. FILE ownership remains with caller.

checks.subject: Transparent pixels, mapping and clipping
checks.result: Source index 0 is skipped; mapping[1..255] is initialized deterministically by first valid candidate. Squared RGB distance is at most 195075, within int range. F9..FE excluded. Each destination write uses screen width/height and pitch; signed PAL_X/Y permit clipping. Existing 8-bit software-screen contract is retained.

checks.subject: Compatibility and version rejection
checks.result: No package, unmapped ID or native-dimension mismatch uses the original RLE path. Resource mode is detected before text initialization. A configured missing/invalid/version-mismatched package makes PAL_InitText fail and the application initialization stop, rather than silently applying an incorrect package.

checks.subject: Configuration lifecycle
checks.result: New enum appended; default NULL; configuration read/write/Get/Set/Free covered. Path opens in rb mode, absolute paths supported and relative paths resolved against GamePath. No unconfigured-path behavior change found.

checks.subject: Palette behavior scope
checks.result: Mapping uses PAT base selected by global palette number/night flag and does not call VIDEO_SetPalette. Existing palette fades affect the resulting indexed pixels. This is quantization to the PC scene palette, not a lossless independent RGB portrait layer.

checks.subject: Converter source and palette fidelity
checks.result: Fixed Win/DOS RGM, SSS and M.MSG hashes match prior independent review; PAT hashes independently match local files; fixed Saturn RGM.JOE/ALLDAT.NEW/PROG.BIN hashes independently match extracted files. 0x2800 slots, BE16 dimensions, row-bounded >127 skip RLE, opaque-zero rejection, one ignored tail byte, ALLDAT bank3 [0x600:0x800], BE555 and c5<<3 RGB agree with source investigation.

checks.subject: Identity whitelist and traceable evidence
checks.result: Current 86 identity_ids exactly equal independent Win and DOS lists. ID38 excluded; unused/unconfirmed IDs not included. Condensed per-ID review has exactly those86 IDs and its full-anchor SHA references match both full external anchor files. Source-review copy SHA matches manifest source_review_sha256.

checks.subject: Conversion output and input protection
checks.result: Aspect-fit uses exact Fraction ratio capped at1, transparent centered padding, and explicit floor nearest sampling; no interpolation introduces new indices. Output holds preserved source RGB palette plus fitted index planes, target tag and native dimensions. All inputs and entries are validated before creating the new output directory; existing output directories are refused. Original inputs are read only.

checks.subject: Renderer scope and old modes
checks.result: Portrait fixture calls production PAL_StartDialog and archives screen indices/current palette; same native dimensions/positions and clipping are used. Optional7th arg supplies portrait package; previous6-argument old-mode decisions remain equivalent. Updated publish==2 sets a black display palette before first draw, so an external pixel verifier can distinguish base-palette mapping from incorrectly matching current black palette. Backup/restore compares all indexed screen bytes.

checks.subject: Current unit-test scope
checks.result: Static review sees synthetic RLE/fit/MKF/input-output protections, target/header/ID/size/reserved/truncation/duplicate/trailing package rejection, and configuration default/set/get/clear tests. Tests were not executed by this reviewer.

checks.subject: Existing-frame recheck boundary
checks.result: --check-existing validates binary, PC-resource and package identities plus pinned R2 SLF hashes; requires existing input fixtures to agree; skips run_renderer and reruns comparison logic against stored frames. The output explicitly records rechecked_existing_frames_without_rerender. This is validation of an existing renderer run, not a new renderer execution.

resolved_findings.finding: The source decoder rejected dimensions >=128, but reviewed Saturn whitelist slots 84, 90 and 91 are 133x111, 128x109 and 128x109. Correct pinned source conversion would stop at ID84.
resolved_findings.independent_evidence: Read BE16 dimensions directly from extracted RGM.JOE at id*0x2800; no converter execution.
resolved_findings.correction_reviewed: Saturn source now accepts width<=256,height<=200. PC dimensions and engine package loader accept width<=320,height<=200. Parent additionally identified native PC dimensions above127 (ID72/84). Existing screen clipping and native-size equality gate retained.
tests_seen_not_executed: tests/test_portrait_conversion.py:34-39 covers source width133, native135x131 and fit extent
resolved_findings.status: resolved by static review of current files

resolved_findings.subject: Expected output coverage and exported base frames are not bound to validated fixtures
resolved_findings.evidence: The metadata loop consumes whatever rows exist and trusts emitted x/y/stage. No exact row sequence/count or generated-fixture equality is required. Header-only CSV plus empty frame stream reaches all_indexed_pixels_and_palettes_exact=True; verify_scales also accepts an empty BMP set. Legacy CSV/BMP checks iterate only current outputs, so missing outputs are not independently rejected. Base BMP is compared only to its own scaled files, never to the validated binary frame.
resolved_findings.minimum_correction: Construct the complete expected row sequence (including position, stage, initial_black and offset) from fixtures/native dimensions and compare exactly; require expected matrix/legacy file sets; compare each published base BMP RGB to its validated stage0 indexed frame/palette before checking scales.

final_resolution.assessment: Complete expected metadata includes exact names, ID, location, palette/night, width/height, position, stage, initial_black and offset. Each row must equal its expected row and final count must match. Frame stream must end exactly. Published BMP sets are exact/nonempty and base BMP RGB must equal validated stage0 data. Legacy BMP/CSV sets must match the complete historical sets; scaled sets are exact.

resolved_findings.subject: Menu phase exception is not restricted to selected-name ink
resolved_findings.evidence: Any changed position with both indices in249..254 is accepted. For example, a single background pixel249->250 passes even if unrelated to the selected name. Different pixels can use unrelated phase deltas. Palette equality and same coordinates do not establish glyph identity.
resolved_findings.minimum_correction: Use the actual expected selected-name glyph ink mask/positions and require one consistent modulo6 color phase; all remaining indices and palette bytes remain exact.

final_resolution.assessment: Allowed selected-name pixels now come from SLF WORDS, source Japanese glyph dots/width and known menu fixture coordinates. Every changed pixel must lie in that independent mask and both colors must be249..254. Nonzero phase changes must cover the complete mask, have one modulo6 delta, and each side must use one uniform selected color. All other indices and the full palette remain equal. The prior arbitrary-background-index exception is removed.

resolved_findings.subject: Preview RGB reference can come from a pack different from the verified pack
resolved_findings.evidence: The exporter accepts an independent pack_root and does not compare that pack SHA with verification.json versions.win.pack_sha256. A verified A render can therefore be composed with a B pack RGB reference while the caption calls it verified source RGB.
resolved_findings.minimum_correction: Require the selected package SHA to equal the corresponding verification report pack_sha256 before reading its palette/entries.

final_resolution.assessment: Exporter now checks pack SHA against verified package, both relevant metadata/frame hashes, and every input image SHA against the pixel-verification report. The visible reference label now says Saturn RGB / fitted. It cannot silently mix a different pack with verified rendered images under the previous interface.

nonblocking_validation_boundaries.subject: Configuration persistence
nonblocking_validation_boundaries.detail: Read/write code is wired consistently, but the current configuration test checks in-memory Set/Get/Clear only. It does not itself prove PAL_SaveConfig then PAL_LoadConfig(TRUE) filesystem round-trip. Do not label that round-trip executed without a separate result.

nonblocking_validation_boundaries.subject: Palette-phase evidence
nonblocking_validation_boundaries.detail: Stage1 directly applies the same F9..FE rotation; stage2 directly halves palette RGB; stage3 directly sets black. They validate controlled palette changes, not the complete real PAL_DialogWaitForKey or PAL_FadeOut event/timing path. Initial-black draw fixture exists, but successful validation is the parent pixel verifier responsibility.

nonblocking_validation_boundaries.subject: Color and gameplay
nonblocking_validation_boundaries.detail: Runtime nearest-color quantization is lossy and tied to selected PC PAT base palette. No independent RGB layer, exact Saturn display color, actual Saturn layer-switch timing, natural dialogue route or full gameplay acceptance is established by this review.

preview_label_review.assessment: Visible label Saturn RGB / fitted now matches the aspect-fitted original-color reconstruction. Comments/purpose and documentation distinguish source-rendered PC/SDLPAL crops from the reference and disclaim live screenshots.
preview_label_review.no_claim: No original Saturn or PAL98 live screenshot is established.

documentation_review.assessment: No blocking overclaim found: document distinguishes palette probes from real wait/fade execution, fitting and lossy quantization from RGB preservation, source rendering from gameplay, and explicit pending user acceptance. It correctly limits configuration verification to memory API tests and static file-read/write review.
nonblocking_refinements_sent_to_parent: Mention --check-existing explicitly in final verification narrative so readers distinguish stored-frame recheck from rerender.
Update menu-animation wording to name the complete independent glyph mask and uniform modulo6 phase now enforced, rather than only the weaker index-range condition.

visual_review.method: Viewed actual exported PNGs, not inferred from code.
visual_review.result: Labels, portraits and Japanese text visible; night quantization difference explicit.
